title: 寻猫：一页可以转的漫画
titleEn: Lost Cat — a comic page you can spin
summary: Qwen Image 2.1 画六格剧情漫画，每格用 MiniMax-H3 + ORB360 LoRA 生成 360° 环绕视频，再用 three.js 拼成一页：拖动任意一格就能绕着角色转，点一格推近看，第二格的寻猫启事还藏了彩蛋。
summaryEn: Six comic panels drawn with Qwen Image 2.1, each turned into a 360° orbit video with MiniMax-H3 + the ORB360 LoRA, then assembled into one three.js page: drag any panel to circle the characters, click to zoom in — and try the Lost Cat poster in panel 2.
notes: 每一格的环绕都成立：转一圈回到原图，背面补得合理，角色前后一致，双人格也能一起转。
Every orbit closes the loop: plausible back views, consistent characters, even two people turning together.
官方提示词会把室内背景补成户外（草地、雪）；给每格写清 360° 环境后，卧室和菜市场都修好了。
The stock prompt turns indoor scenes into outdoor ones (grass, snow); describing each panel’s surroundings fixed the bedroom and the market.
提示词改不了图里已有的遮挡：主角背后贴着墙或广告牌，转到背面就看不到人，出图时要给背后留空。
Prompts can’t remove occluders already in the image — leave space behind the subject when drawing the panel.
